system.description: Protective Aura (Su): Against attacks made or effects created by evil creatures, this ability provides a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws to anyone within 20 feet of the angel. Otherwise, it functions as magic circle against evil and lesser globe of invulnerability, both with a radius of 20 feet (caster level equals the angel’s HD). The aura can be dispelled; the angel can recreate it as a free action on its next turn. Defensive benefits from the circle are not included in the printed statistics block.
